title: UFOs, big cats and Nessie: what explains where people see them?
excerpt: 1,905 UK UFO reports, 1,145 Loch Ness sightings and 44 police forces' replies about big cats, tested against people, skies, air bases, seasons and the news. The ordinary explanations win.
seo_description: UK UFO reports follow people, not skies or air bases; Nessie sightings follow the newspapers and summer days; big cats live in police files.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'UFOs, big cats and Nessie' with a map of UK UFO reports as violet dots, an outline of Loch Ness and a bar of Nessie sightings by year.
